verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo has shrunk to a tiny mark in the top-left with a broken wordmark that reads 'Merid an', which damages the brand. The copy reads '$199 / New York / from', so 'from' now trails the city instead of introducing the price. The suitcase sits tight to the top edge and the Book button floats alone on the right. B: the logo is intact and legible, but it has been pushed to the bottom as an afterthought, and 'from' is an orphaned speck beside it ('Meridian from'), so the price loses its qualifier. The suitcase is crammed against the top and left edges. B wins narrowly because its brand mark survives and its price-and-city block reads more cleanly.
